Nested on-treatment liver-test elevation table

Source: R/build_hyslaw_table.R
build_liver_elevation_table.Rd

Counts subjects whose peak on-treatment ULN ratio meets 3/5/10/20x (transaminases) or 1.5/2x (bilirubin, ALP), then the combination of concurrent biochemical Hy's Law split by ALP in the window.

Usage

build_liver_elevation_table(
  adsl = NULL,
  adlb = NULL,
  arm_var = "TRT01A",
  show_total = TRUE,
  title = "Maximal on-treatment liver test elevations (exploratory)",
  footnotes = NULL,
  classified = NULL,
  at_cuts = c(3, 5, 10, 20),
  bili_cuts = c(1.5, 2),
  alp_cuts = c(1.5, 2),
  ...
)

Arguments

adsl

ADSL-like data. Ignored when classified is supplied.

adlb

ADLB-like data.

arm_var

Treatment / grouping variable.

show_total

Whether to add a Total column.

title

Table title.

footnotes

Optional footnotes.

classified

Optional list from classify_hyslaw().

at_cuts

Transaminase ULN multiples.

bili_cuts

Bilirubin ULN multiples.

alp_cuts

ALP ULN multiples.

...

Passed to classify_hyslaw() when classified is NULL.

Value

An rtables VTableTree.
